snippet.title: The Haunted Mansion PS2 Trailer - Official U.S. PlayStation Magazine Issue 75 (December 2003)
snippet.description:
Featured from Official U.S. PlayStation Magazine Issue 75 (December 2003).

Credit to Videogamesyo.

Updated as of 4/14/2021- Description:
Unlike the other two trailers, this one was long as expected. I’m NOT gonna say it’s a rip-off of Luigi’s Mansion, but this game was better than the Eddie Murphy’s movie in my opinion. It has some dark atmosphere based on the ride of the same name. I used to beat that game like in 3 times per year for now.
